newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY CEN. BANK REDUCES REPO RATES BY 0.25 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY CEN. BANK REDUCES REPO RATES BY 0.25 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary said on Friday it had reduced all of its five repo rates by 0.25 percentage points each, effective immediately.

The overnight repo rate has been reduced to 26.75 percent from 27 percent, the one-week repo rate to 26.75 percent from 27 percent, the overnight reverse repo rate was cut to 17.25 percent from 17.50 percent.
The one-week reverse repo rate was cut to 20.75 percent, from 21.00 percent and the one-month reverse repo rate was cut to 21.25 percent from 21.50 percent.

The National Bank of Hungary also reduced its interest rates on spot foreign currency buying and concomittent foreign currency futures sales to 26.75 percent from 27 percent, also effective immediately, the NBH said in a statement.
"The NBH regards as appropriate the interest rates for periods longer than one month," the statement said.

"The 25 basis points reduction of the one-month and shorter-term repo rates means that the central bank's interest curve becomes more homogenous and is in line with the expected course of moderate yield reduction."
